text: Teaching Objectives To cultivate high-qualified and skilled talents who are proficient in Chinese language and culture, who will have a good understanding of knowledge in international trade, management, and finance as well as the experience in operating and handling real-life projects, especially those pertaining to Chinese economy, society, and who understand the Chinese culture values, so that they can meet the demands of the fast changing world economy. Main Courses Introduction to Business, Financial Accounting, Strategy Management,International Business,International Finance and Banking,Marketing Basics, Human Resource Management, Information and Data Management, Managerial Accounting, Management Essentials, Organizational Behavior, Basic Statistics, Basic Mathematics of Commerce, Microeconomics, Operational Management, International Trade, Customer Relationship MG, International Law and International Relations, Business Finance, Cross Cultural Communication for Effective Leadership and MGT Internship With CPD’s (Center of Professional Development) help, students can be recommended to transnational companies for internship to get their work experience in the last semester. Industry partners of CPD include Standard Chartered Bank, ABN AMRO BANK, HSBC, Hang Seng Bank, United Overseas Bank, Xinhua Finance, Coca Cola, IBM, Apple, HP, Dell, Imaginex, Microsoft, Motorola, NOKIA, Vogue, ELLE, Samsung, Finnair, IKEA, Tiffany, L'oreal, Elite Ogilvy, AKQA, Dunhill, Hugo Boss, Louis Vuitton, Cartier, Ferragamo, ZARA, Adidas, Nike, Prada, Giorgio Armani, and many more... Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Management in Business Administration (BBA) Future Career Students will be provided the opportunities to be engaged in industrial cooperative projects, resume instructions and review, visits to companies, interview techniques, and career consultation.
